newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken calls branches core operations - report.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken calls branches core operations - report.

text.p: Swedish bank S-E-Banken says its branch offices belonged to its core activities, weekly Veckans Affarer reported on Tuesday.
"The branch offices are not just a distribution channel," Monica Caneman, deputy chief executive of S-E-Banken, was quoted as saying.

"At the offices, we handle 99 percent of our customers. The branch offices are part of S-E-Banken's core operations. They have a role to fill, both as a business of their own and as supporting units for other business areas."
Speculation has targeted a breaking up of the bank into retail banking, which would encompass the branch offices, and investment banking.
When asked about whether asset management could be separated from the offices, she told the weekly:
"We will focus more on funds and insurances and then branch offices will become very important. These products benefit from a branch office network."
Having branch offices opens up for streamlining banking operations, she told Veckans Affarer.
"Branch offices will in the future get a new role as advisors and sales places for more advanced deals," she was quoted as saying.
"The development naturally creates potential for rationalisation."
